description: This class represents a form backing bean for uploading digital product files within an admin interface of the Shopizer e-commerce platform. It encapsulates uploaded files, product references, and validation logic for handling file uploads associated with a product.

classes.name: ProductFiles
classes.description: A serializable Java bean that stores uploaded digital product files, the associated product, and digital product metadata, with validation annotations for form processing.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the list of uploaded multipart files; validated with NotEmpty annotation.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of uploaded multipart files.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product with this instance.

methods.name: setDigitalProduct
methods.description: Associates a DigitalProduct with this instance.
